feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 May 2026 4:27pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 22 May 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Low cloud and mist continue to affect parts of the island, however some brighter spells may break through at times, with a moderate south to southwest wind, feeling fresher along the coast.

A few spots of light, patchy rain may arrive later this evening, clearing away early in the night as the wind eases. Minimum temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

A fine weekend ahead with light winds and a good deal of sunshine. Temperatures generally in the mid-teens, however we could see 18 or 19°C in the north.
